published.why: Same passes, different denominator. The report scores the 6 tasks that ran to completion and sets the 3 cli tasks aside as provider cut-offs. Here the denominator is every task the grader actually scored, so those 3 are counted (as failures) and flagged as cut-short. One further task never reached the grader and is listed as no-verdict.
Matches. Both sides exclude the 2 tasks that lost their patch and count the killed sympy-13031 run as a failure.

The frozen first pass ran 4 of 5 tasks (grpc-go never called the model) and resolved 1, which is the 1/4 shown above. A later regrade, after the rule that forbade touching existing test files was corrected, resolved 2 more from the same patches with no new model calls.
